summary: XOMA Royalty Corp entered into a merger agreement with Ligand Pharmaceuticals (parent) and its wholly-owned subsidiary, Flex Merger Sub, Inc., whereby Merger Sub will merge into a new holding company (HoldCo) following a reorganization, making HoldCo a wholly-owned subsidiary of Parent. Shareholders of XOMA Royalty common stock will receive $39.00 per share in cash plus contingent value rights (CVRs) derived from an interest in RemainCo LLC. The board of XOMA recommended the deal; no advisors named. The transaction implies a premium from the undisturbed price. The CVR structure adds a contingent component; customary regulatory approvals are required. What to watch: shareholder vote on the holding company reorganization and merger, risk-arb spread versus $39 cash plus CVR valuation.
